description: Incident scenarios paired with the documents that should inform a diagnosis and the terms a useful answer is expected to contain. Used to score retrieval and groundedness of the generated diagnosis together, since a well-grounded answer over the wrong documents is still wrong.
limitations: Single-annotator labels over a corpus of vendor documentation, fifteen cases. Expected terms are a coarse relevance check, not a correctness oracle: a diagnosis can contain every expected term and still be wrong. Treated as a regression guard, not a benchmark.
